summary: RYTHM, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026 disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary VCP IP Holdings, LLC and GTI Core, LLC, an indirect unit of Green Thumb Industries, amended their August 27, 2025 Trademark and Recipe License Agreement on October 13, 2026. The amendment adds the Se orita brand to licensed IP, limits GTI Core's rights to state-regulated dispensary channels, and raises base licensing fees by $250,000 annually. Green Thumb holds roughly 32% of RYTHM, with rights to about 90%. No board recommendation or advisor named. Terms are contractual, not a special situation.
